operations.description: List accessible calendars with IDs, access roles, and time zones. Follow continuation.

transform.source: return function(response) local d=json.decode(response.body); local out=json.array(); for _,v in ipairs(d.items or {}) do local s=json.encode(v); out[#out+1]={id=v.id,record_json=#s<=1800 and s or "",too_large=#s>1800} end; return {records=out} end

operations.description: Read calendar details and time zone. Check too_large.

arguments.name: calendarId
arguments.description: Exact calendarId from a prior read.

transform.source: return function(response) local d=json.decode(response.body); local s=json.encode(d); if #s>4500 then return {record_json="",too_large=true} end; return {record_json=s,too_large=false} end
